themes.label: Friendly, fast service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the staff as friendly, attentive and quick, though a few describe slow or rude service and an uneven experience depending on the waitress.
quotes: Great food, fast & friendly service!
The host was rude and lacked professionalism. The service is slow.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the diner food good or delicious, but some find it mediocre, with complaints about salty fries, dry pork chops and undercooked egg whites.
quotes: Good diner food. Always too cold inside.
Don't get the pork chops because it's broiled so it's super dry and the flavor wasn't all there.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many reviewers describe prices as good or affordable, while two call the diner overpriced or a little pricey.
quotes: Amazing food with amazing prices. Love this place
WAY OVER PRICED! Food is good.

themes.label: Cozy, family atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe a small, cozy, family-friendly neighborhood diner with a pleasant, down-to-earth atmosphere and loyal long-time customers.
quotes: Good food, pleasant atmosphere, family-orientated, great prices and the friendliest waitresses.
This place has a peaceful environment with good food.

themes.label: Free parking
themes.text: Reviewers appreciate the free and available parking at the diner.
quotes: Free available parking makes it perfect.
A little pricey but free parking makes up for it.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Many reviewers praise tasty, flavorful food, while others describe tough or flavorless meat, rubbery or spoiled dishes, and food that tastes bad.
quotes: I love the way their chicken is flavored with just the right amount of seasoning.
Steak was over-seasoned with salt and vinegar, as if the steak was ready to go bad and they had to cover it up.

themes.label: Staff attitude and service
themes.text: Some find staff courteous, friendly and attentive, but others report rude staff, poor customer service, and worse treatment for those not speaking Spanish.
quotes: The staff is always courteous and the food is great.
The waitresses behind the counter have the worst attitude, which is definitely hurting the business.

themes.label: Wait and delivery times
themes.text: Several reviewers describe long waits and late, cold deliveries, though a few say service is fast or delivery is quick.
quotes: food came at 157pm..the food was super cold as if it was mad early in da day and just left sitting there
Delivery is rather quick, maybe a half hour or so.

themes.label: Smell and cleanliness
themes.text: Reviewers complain of bad smells inside the restaurant, including a sewer odor, though one reviewer calls the place clean.
quotes: Smells like sewer in the dining room.
it doesn't smell good inside it's supposed to smell like food

themes.label: Prices, billing and payment
themes.text: Reviewers cite overpriced food, changing prices, billing mistakes, and cash-only or unreliable card payment, though a few say prices are reasonable.
quotes: This place card system is always down. We are in a generation where people don't carry much cash.
Plus the food is way overpriced!! They need to make better food & lower the costs!!!

themes.label: Long waiting times
themes.text: Many reviewers say orders take very long, often an hour or more, though some accept the wait because the food is freshly made.
quotes: Food is good but get ready to wait a very long time for it about an hour plus
The food is very good but what I did not like is that it takes more than an hour to serve it

themes.label: Honduran food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the authentic, fresh, homemade Honduran food, especially baleadas, tacos, chicken with slices and soups, though a few call it flavorless or horrible.
quotes: You want Honduras true culture food come here, you won't regret.
I Love the baleadas and tacos hondureños here.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Some reviewers praise friendly, caring staff and the owner, while others describe poor service or unkind servers.
quotes: Food is good But service Sucks
A small place but with excellent service and exquisite food.

themes.label: Small cramped space
themes.text: Reviewers describe the restaurant as very small or a hole in the wall, with some wanting better presentation or more room.

the place is very small and it takes longer than normal
